title: 2020 American Heart Association Guidelines for Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation and Emergency Cardiovascular Care
claims: The 2020 guidelines are aligned with the International Liaison Committee on Resuscitation and emphasise early recognition and activation of the chain of survival.
Unresponsiveness with absent or abnormal breathing is the recognition trigger for bystander action in adults.
The guidelines recommend immediate emergency calling and rapid access to an automated external defibrillator by trained or untrained bystanders.
